definitions.gloss: general; broad; sweeping; comprehensive in outline
definitions.explanation: Covering the main points without going into detail. Describes an overview or summary that captures the big picture rather than specifics.

examples.japanese: {概括的|がいかつてき}な⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧。
⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧{概括的|がいかつてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{述|の}べて→述べる：02389_noberu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}ります→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I'll give a broad overview first, then go into the details.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{概括的|がいかつてき}な⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{示|しめ}されて→示す：01948_shimesu⟧おり、⟦{個別|こべつ}→個別：11566_kobetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれていない→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: The report only shows general trends and does not include individual data.

notes:
Composed of {概括|がいかつ} (generalization; summarization) and ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjective suffix). Used in formal and academic contexts when describing something that covers main points without exhaustive detail.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {概括的|がいかつてき}な⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧: general explanation
- {概括的|がいかつてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧: to describe broadly
- {概括的|がいかつてき}な⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧: broad understanding
- {概括的|がいかつてき}な⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧: general trend

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大|おお}まか→大まか：07664_oomaka⟧: rough; approximate — more casual and everyday
- ⟦{包括的|ほうかつてき}→包括的：06711_houkatsuteki⟧: comprehensive; inclusive — emphasizes covering everything, not simplifying
- {総括的|そうかつてき}: summarizing; comprehensive — close synonym, emphasizes summation
- {大体|だいたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: rough; approximate — colloquial

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in academic papers, reports, presentations, and official documents.
